signals.summary: Stripe laid off 300 employees, roughly 3.5% of staff, mainly in product, engineering and operations.
Company said it is not slowing hiring and expects to reach about 10,000 employees, a 17% year-over-year increase.
Stripe executed a $6.5B secondary market raise to cover RSU taxes and give employees liquidity.
Stripe says businesses on its platform generated $1.9 trillion in payment volume in 2025.
